title: Cam Anthony delivers a new single "Keep It Between Us"
htmlContent:
R&B artist Cam Anthony presents a new single "Keep It Between Us," after signed to Republic Records, he introduces himself with a new track “Keep It Between Us” and many more to come. The track threads dreamy guitar around a throwback-style beat. Right out of the gate, his vocals take flight with a show-stopping performance highlighted by jaw-dropping falsetto and a soaring hook.

Cam Anthony's “Keep It Between Us” is a record that doesn’t miss on its pursuit to deliver a masterpiece. It shines in every way to make a song you can get lost in with every aspect of the record doing its part. The production sets the tone for this master jam, the lyrics stand out in the verses and take off in the chorus, and the vocal presence gets the job done to make sure we find our new favorite song.
